authorization: User approved pooled additive Cat + CNN and requested G4 be marked unsupported.
model: eta = beta + c(a_cat)-c(b_cat) + w^T(z(a_image)-z(b_image)); no demographic/context interactions.
objective: Mean response-weighted stable logistic loss + lambda_cat/2 * ||c||^2 + lambda_cnn/2 * ||w||^2 + 1e-6/2 * beta^2.

selection.tie_rule: within 1e-6 prefer larger cat ridge, then larger CNN ridge
selection.optimizer: original float64 analytic-gradient zero-start L-BFGS-B; original retry and gradient <1e-5 acceptance
selection.preprocessing: Original C transform refit on unique fitting photos of each G2/G3/curve split.
selection.freeze: Seal selected model and fitting-only transformations after validation selection, before reanalysis of previously saved test outcomes.

evaluation.g2: original common fit, validation and strict-test rows; pair bootstrap
evaluation.g3: separate refit and tuning on existing G3 core fitting/validation; saved G3 test outcomes; held-out-photo bootstrap
evaluation.g4: unsupported by explicit user choice; no unseen cat identity score is assigned or evaluated
evaluation.bootstrap: 5000 shared cluster resamples, seed 20261101, 95% pointwise unadjusted intervals
evaluation.learning_curves: original seeds 20261030 and 20261031; 25/50/75/100% pairs; original common validation intersection; refit preprocessing, identities and retune full grid
evaluation.temperature: original grid [0.25,0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,4] selected on validation by minimum loss; do not promote
evaluation.fair_coin: 20 independent fit/validation repetitions seed 20261102; fixed selected settings; investigation trigger >=16 improvements or any failed fit
evaluation.abstention: fixed thresholds 0.5 to 1 by .025, correct +1, incorrect -1, abstain 0; denominator all original test responses; no threshold selected

limitations: Post-test, retrospective, not independent or confirmatory; all G2 and G3 outcomes were previously exposed.
Cat and CNN score components are not uniquely identified by likelihood; ridge penalties influence allocation. Do not interpret as a causal or behavioral decomposition.
G4 unsupported: the user declined the zero-score cold-start convention; no G4 predictions or performance are reported.
Different penalty tuning searches and model complexity affect comparisons; conditional pair/photo bootstrap omits model-selection/training and some respondent/shared-image dependence.
No frozen primary claim, model, report, package or official prediction will be replaced.
